name: com.complianceautomator/public-mcp
title: ComplianceAutomator Public MCP
description: Public read-only MCP for products, frameworks, guides, methodology, and published blog metadata.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List public ComplianceAutomator document kits and bundles with framework coverage. Use this before requesting one product by id.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get allowlisted public details for one product. This does not purchase a product or access customer data.

tools.name: list_frameworks
tools.description: List frameworks represented in the public catalog and the public products mapped to each framework.

tools.name: get_methodology
tools.description: Return the public document-readiness methodology and its boundaries. This is educational material, not a compliance determination.

tools.name: get_how_it_works
tools.description: Return a public overview of the purchase, intake, generation, and delivery workflow without order or portal records.

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: List published public guide metadata, optionally filtered by framework. Use get_guide with a returned slug for a summary.

framework.description: Optional exact framework label such as SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, or ISO 27001.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Get allowlisted metadata and a short plain-text summary for one published guide. Private documents and customer evidence are excluded.

tools.name: list_blog_posts
tools.description: List metadata for published ComplianceAutomator blog posts. Draft and unpublished content is excluded.

tools.name: get_blog_post
tools.description: Get allowlisted metadata and a short excerpt for one published post. Draft content is excluded.
